backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining worker categories/subcategories (Household, Vehicle, Construction, etc.), integrating blob storage and authorization mixins, and exposing public types for category mappings.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three homepage text updates (title, subtitle in Tamil, search placeholder) with high confidence and test IDs REQ-1, REQ-2, REQ-3.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including styling (vibrant OKLCH colors), landing page components (hero, benefits, testimonials), registration modal, and configuration files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_CLEAN_REBUILD.md: Documentation for performing a clean production rebuild by clearing Vite cache, dist folder, and package manager cache to ensure fresh build artifacts.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_LIVE_NO_DRAFT.md: Guide for deploying directly to live domain (areaworkars.caffeine.ai) without draft/preview, including prerequisites and deployment flow steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, defining design tokens for background, foreground, primary, secondary, accent, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags for AREA WORKARS app, describing it as a platform to find local skilled workers like plumbers, electricians, and carpenters.
Bash script that removes build caches (node_modules/.vite, dist), prunes pnpm store, runs production build, and verifies dist/index.html exists.
frontend/scripts/deploy-live.sh: Deployment script that verifies build artifacts exist, deploys to areaworkars.caffeine.ai (live only, no draft), and runs post-deploy verification.
frontend/scripts/verify-live-deploy.sh: Post-deployment verification script that checks areaworkars.caffeine.ai for HTTP 200 status, presence of div#root, valid HTML structure, and adequate response size with retry logic.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes (home, search, register, post-job, admin, blog, worker profile), QueryClient, I18nProvider, and Layout with HeaderBar/FooterBar.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Protects admin routes by checking authentication and admin privileges, displaying loading states or access denied screens with bilingual messages and login prompts when unauthorized.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminJobPo: Placeholder component for job post management that displays a message indicating the feature is not yet available.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminWorke: Admin interface for managing workers with filtering by status (all/active/rejected), displaying worker details in cards, and providing reject functionality with reason prompts.
frontend/src/components/common/RouteErro: Error boundary component that catches route rendering errors and displays a user-friendly error message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/common/SafeIconI: Image component with automatic fallback handling that switches to a default icon when the source fails to load, with single-attempt error recovery.
frontend/src/components/i18n/BilingualTe: Renders English and regional language text side-by-side with customizable container and text styling through className props.
frontend/src/components/i18n/I18nProvide: Provides internationalization context with Tamil as the fixed primary language, offering translation function that returns bilingual text with safety guards to prevent raw keys from displaying.
English translation dictionary containing all UI strings organized by feature (home, navigation, registration, worker profiles, search, jobs, admin, footer, categories).
Tamil translation dictionary mirroring the English locale structure with translations for all UI strings across the application.
frontend/src/components/i18n/translation: Flattens nested JSON translations into dot-notation keys, builds bilingual dictionary, and provides getTranslation function with humanized fallbacks that convert missing keys to Title Case instead of showing raw keys.
frontend/src/components/jobs/JobBoard.ts: Placeholder component for a future job board feature, displaying a message that the feature is not yet available.
frontend/src/components/landing/FooterBa: Footer component displaying app branding, bilingual messaging about no middleman/commission, WhatsApp contact button, and copyright with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/landing/HeaderBa: Navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile menus for home, browse, register worker, and admin (if authenticated), with responsive mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/layout/PageShell: Reusable page wrapper component providing consistent gradient background and responsive padding with default or compact variants.
frontend/src/components/search/HomeWorke: Displays worker search results preview with cards showing worker details, skills, location, and action buttons for WhatsApp/call contact.
frontend/src/components/search/LiveSugge: Search input with live autocomplete suggestions dropdown, keyboard navigation support (arrows, enter, escape), and click-outside handling.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchEmp: Empty state component for search results showing a message with category browse suggestions and a button to try a different search.
frontend/src/components/search/VoiceSear: Voice search toggle button with mic icon that shows listening state with animation and tooltip, hidden if voice search is not supported.
frontend/src/components/workers/WorkerCa: React component that displays a worker's profile card with name, skills, location, and contact buttons (call/WhatsApp), navigating to worker detail on click.
Configuration file defining local skilled worker subcategories with icons and bilingual labels (English/Tamil) for various trades like Mason, Carpenter, Welder, etc.
frontend/src/config/payment.ts: Empty configuration file, likely placeholder for payment-related settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor with Internet Identity authentication, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminMutations.ts: React Query mutation hook for admin operations, currently providing worker rejection functionality with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBrowserGeolocation: Hook for requesting browser geolocation with status tracking, timeout handling, and both interactive and one-shot fetch modes.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebouncedValue.ts: Simple hook that debounces a changing value with configurable delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useIntentWorkerSearch: React Query hook for intent-based worker search that attempts backend API first, falling back to client-side smart search with query normalization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveSearchSuggesti: React Query hook that fetches live search suggestions from backend for a given prefix with minimum length validation and normalization.
frontend/src/hooks/useNaturalLanguageWor: Hook that fetches public workers and uses smart search utilities to return ranked, limited matches for a natural language query with spelling correction and priority ranking.
frontend/src/hooks/useNearbyWorkers.ts: Hook for location-based worker queries that currently returns an empty array since the backend doesn't support location-based search.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching public workers, checking admin status, getting caller user profile, and fetching individual workers by ID with error handling and caching.
Hook that wraps the Web Speech API to provide voice recognition for Tamil and English with error handling, browser support detection, and transcript callbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerSearch.ts: Hook that fetches public workers and filters them by area, category, and subcategory with case-insensitive matching.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTaxonomy.ts: Hook that fetches worker categories and subcategories from the backend with fallback taxonomy data, deduplication, and defensive validation to ensure pages render even if the backend fails.
frontend/src/hooks/useWorkerTextSearch.t: Hook that performs fuzzy text search across worker name, area, category, and skills fields using a 75% similarity threshold.
frontend/src/icons/AgricultureIcon.tsx: SVG icon component depicting a plant with stem, leaves, and soil representing the agriculture category.
frontend/src/icons/ConstructionIcon.tsx: SVG icon component showing crossed hammer and wrench tools representing the construction category.
frontend/src/icons/CookingIcon.tsx: SVG icon component displaying a cooking pot with steam, balloons, and confetti representing events and cooking services.
frontend/src/icons/HelperIcon.tsx: SVG icon component showing two hands holding a heart representing daily helpers and care services.
frontend/src/icons/HomeIcon.tsx: SVG icon component depicting a house with roof, door, windows, and sparkles representing home services.
frontend/src/icons/RepairIcon.tsx: SVG icon component showing a wrench, screwdriver, and bolt representing repair services.
frontend/src/icons/SuppliesIcon.tsx: SVG icon component displaying a cardboard box with tape and label representing supplies and delivery services.
frontend/src/icons/TransportIcon.tsx: React component that renders an SVG icon of a truck with wheels, cabin, and motion lines, styled with purple colors and customizable className.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a vibrant color theme (green primary, blue secondary, orange accent) and base styles for typography and layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin panel page with tabs for reviewing workers and job posts, protected by AdminGuard and using bilingual text throughout.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Blog listing page displaying three hardcoded blog posts about AREA WORKARS with titles, excerpts, dates, and authors.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page with hero section, natural language search box with voice input, live worker preview results, and browsable category grid.
frontend/src/pages/JobRequestPage.tsx: Placeholder page for job posting feature that displays a 'not yet available' message with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerProfilePage.tsx: Worker detail page displaying profile information (name, phone, area, category, skills, experience) with WhatsApp and call action buttons.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerRegistrationPag: Worker registration form page with fields for name, phone, area, category, skills, availability, and experience, with validation and backend submission.
frontend/src/pages/WorkerSearchResultsPa: Main search results page component that handles worker filtering by category, area, and text query using intent-based search, with grouped display by subcategory and empty state recovery.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualFields.ts: Converts field keys (snake_case, camelCase, dotted) into bilingual labels (English and regional/Tamil) by checking i18n translations with fallback to humanized labels.
frontend/src/utils/bilingualTaxonomy.ts: Provides bilingual (English and regional/Tamil) labels for categories and groups using explicit key mappings and i18n translations with fallback to centralized category label helpers.
frontend/src/utils/categoryIcons.ts: Maps category keys to local PNG icon paths with case-insensitive and normalized matching, primarily for subcategories (main categories handled elsewhere).
frontend/src/utils/categoryLabels.ts: Single source of truth for category slug to human-readable display label mappings with strict normalization and intelligent fallback to capitalized words.
frontend/src/utils/displayName.ts: Converts taxonomy slugs (camelCase, concatenated words) into Title Case for display-only usage, handling subcategories and skills with explicit overrides and word-splitting heuristics.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Safely extracts displayable error messages from unknown error values and provides error logging with context.
frontend/src/utils/formatTaxonomyLabel.t: Centralized taxonomy formatter that routes to getCategoryLabel for known categories or displayName for subcategories/skills, converting raw values to Title Case.
frontend/src/utils/fuzzyWorkerSearch.ts: Provides Tamil-safe fuzzy matching utilities using Levenshtein distance for typo-tolerant worker search across name, area, category, and skills fields.
frontend/src/utils/humanizeLabel.ts: Converts raw database keys (camelCase, snake_case) into human-readable Title Case labels and provides bilingual fallbacks for missing translations.
frontend/src/utils/intentQueryNormalizat: Normalizes Tamil and English search queries by removing spoken helper words, handling location suffixes, and mapping skill keywords for backend intent extraction.
frontend/src/utils/mainCategoryIcons.ts: Maps main category names to PNG icon asset paths with case-insensitive matching and fallback handling for the homepage category grid.
frontend/src/utils/nlSearch.ts: Deprecated lightweight natural language search wrapper that now delegates to smartWorkerSearch for unified ranking; provides backward compatibility exports.
frontend/src/utils/normalizeTaxonomy.ts: Provides case-insensitive string normalization and deduplication utilities for standardizing category and subcategory taxonomy values.
frontend/src/utils/smartQueryParser.ts: Parses bilingual Tamil/English queries into structured signals (locations, skills, categories) using token canonicalization and keyword matching.
frontend/src/utils/smartWorkerSearch.ts: Unified worker scoring and ranking system prioritizing location match, then skills (OR logic), then category, with fuzzy matching as tie-breaker; includes non-empty fallback logic.
frontend/src/utils/tokenCanonicalization: Provides token canonicalization for bilingual search with spelling corrections (e.g., 'plambur' → 'plumber'), Tamil-English synonym mappings, and stopword filtering to normalize search queries.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage support for maintaining state like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/src/utils/workerContactLinks.ts: Generates WhatsApp and phone contact links for workers with prefilled messages based on work type, category, and area context; includes phone number sanitization and URL building.
frontend/src/utils/workerDistance.ts: Calculates geographic distance between coordinates using the Haversine formula and formats distances for display (meters for <1km, decimal km for <10km, rounded km otherwise).
frontend/src/utils/workerRelevanceSort.t: Sorts workers by relevance to a search query using smart priority ranking from smartWorkerSearch, falling back to alphabetical order for equal scores.
frontend/src/utils/workerSubgrouping.ts: Groups workers by category (subcategory field removed) for display, normalizing category strings and returning sorted subgroups with their associated workers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended border radius variables, custom shadows, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document showing completed features for updating homepage title, subtitle (Tamil text), and search placeholder text for a worker marketplace platform with Tamil language support.
